digest.component_or_area: Jira reconcile bridge outbound comment sync
propositions: The outbound comment sync re-posted duplicate comments on every hourly reconcile pass because the PRIMARY comment-id dedup map (comment_ids) was inert/empty, leaving only body-membership as the fallback dedup mechanism

REB-1861 reached Jira's 5000-comment hard cap, blocking new comments with COMMENTS_PER_ISSUE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; 30 affected issues accumulated 31,683 total comments with 30,847 bot-marked duplicates across 836 distinct normalized bodies

Phase 1 cleanup executed: 29,931 duplicate bot-authored comments deleted using keep-oldest-per-distinct-normalized-body rule with pre-strip marker detection, pre-deletion backup, completeness gates, and 429 retry handling; REB-1861 reduced from 5000 to 79 comments

Phase 2 remains unexecuted for 836 truncation-suffix comments (body text truncated at 32767 chars, marker paragraph cut off) across REB-1567, REB-1931, and REB-2605, pending operator decision via --include-truncated flag
Post-deletion verification confirmed zero missing distinct bodies, unchanged non-candidate comment counts, and all 30 issues below the 5000-comment cap using independent live-vs-backup diff
The reconcile-bridge workflow remains paused throughout; it was not re-enabled by this cleanup operation
